name: M5.OrderBoundary.signature_lower_bounds
statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (A B : Finset ℕ), F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → M5.PhysicalOrder.realizes N w F A B → M5.signaturePeriod F ∣ N ∧ w ≤ N ∧ F.natDegree < N
context:
theorem M5.OrderBoundary.range_card : ∀ (S : Finset ℕ) (N : ℕ), (∀ e ∈ S, e < N) → S.card ≤ N := by
  change ∀ (S : Finset ℕ) (N : ℕ), (∀ e ∈ S, e < N) → S.card ≤ N
  intro S N h
  have hsub : S ⊆ Finset.range N := by
    intro e he
    exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (h e he)
  simpa only [Finset.card_range] using Finset.card_le_card hsub
guidance: Unfold realizes. Complete signature divides cyclicModulus N and ofSupport A via EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left/right; rewrite its equality to F. M5.Period.period_law gives period divisibility. range_card gives weight bound. support_degree_bound at N gives deg a<N, and a nonzero from coeff0=1 using support_coeff_zero. Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd bounds deg F by deg a. Use explicit gcd arguments. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.
